name: Power Transformer
instruction: Design a power transformer. Start with a large, rectangular core. Add coils around the core, with primary and secondary windings on opposite sides. Include terminals for electrical connections at the top. Surround the core and coils with a protective casing, and add cooling fins on the sides.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a power transformer.
The core is large and rectangular.
Coils are wrapped around the core.
Primary and secondary windings are located on opposite sides of the core.
The terminals for electrical connections are positioned at the top.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The size of the coils is proportionate to the core.
The terminals are adequately sized for functionality.
The cooling fins are proportionate to the size of the transformer.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The coils are correctly positioned around the core.
The primary and secondary windings are placed on opposite sides without interference.
The terminals are accessible at the top of the transformer.
The cooling fins are symmetrically placed on the sides of the casing.
Object distance and contact: The coils do not overlap with the core.
There is no gap between the coils and the core.
The terminals are securely attached to the top of the casing.
The cooling fins are firmly attached to the sides of the casing.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified components are accurately represented.
The design follows the instruction without deviations.
The arrangement of coils, core, terminals, and cooling fins is as instructed.
